[[Category:Activation function]]
[[File:GLU-gating-scalar-view.svg|thumbnail|Scalar view with $w_1=0.8$, $w_2=1.7$: the linear branch $z\,w_1$, the sigmoid gate $f(z\,w_2)$, and their product $\mathrm{GLU}(z)$]]
A gated linear unit (GLU) is a trainable [[activation function]].

$$
\operatorname{GLU}(\mathbf{X})
=\left(\mathbf{X}\mathbf{W}_1+\mathbf{1}\vec b_1^{\top}\right)
\odot f\left(\mathbf{X}\mathbf{W}_2+\mathbf{1}\vec b_2^{\top}\right).
$$

The '''gating function''' $f$ is commonly any of

* [[Gaussian error linear unit (GeLU)]]
* [[sigmoid function]]
* [[(leaky) rectified/exponential linear units (ReLU, LeakyReLU, ELU)]]

 
GLUs are found to improve [[feed-Forward Network (FFN) Sub-Layer (Transformer)|feed-forward sub-layers]] in [[Transformer]]s at matched parameter count.<ref>{{#cite:Q3270}}</ref>
